function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

**Pet‑Friendly Train Stations in Miami** | Station | Address | Pet Policy Highlights | Contact | |---------|---------|-----------------------|---------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (Amtrak)** | 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 | • Small pets (≤ 20 lb) allowed in carriers.
• Must be leashed or in a carrier at all times.
• No pets in the waiting area unless in a carrier.
• Amtrak’s “Pet Friendly” policy applies to all trains departing from this station. | Amtrak Customer Service: 1‑800‑872‑7245 | | **Miami Central Station (Amtrak)** | 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 (same as Intermodal Center) | Same policy as above. | Amtrak Customer Service: 1‑800‑872‑7245 | | **Miami Airport (Amtrak)** | 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 (connected to the airport via the Intermodal Center) | Same policy as above. | Amtrak Customer Service: 1‑800‑872‑7245 | ### How to Verify & Book 1. **Check Amtrak’s Pet Policy** - Visit the Amtrak website’s “Travel with Pets” page: https://www.amtrak.com/pets - Confirm the specific rules for the train you plan to take (e.g., pet fees, carrier requirements). 2. **Call Amtrak Directly** - Phone: **1‑800‑872‑7245** (toll‑free in the U.S.) - Ask about any special accommodations or additional fees for your pet. 3. **Book Your Ticket** - Use the Amtrak website or app to reserve a seat. - When booking, select the “Pet” option (if available) or note that you’ll be traveling with a pet in a carrier. 4. **Arrive Early** - Give yourself extra time to navigate the station with your pet, especially if you’re unfamiliar with the layout. ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Pets - **Carrier Size**: Must fit under the seat or in the luggage area. - **Leash**: Keep your pet on a short leash when outside the carrier. - **Clean Up**: Bring waste bags and clean up after your pet. - **Hydration**: Pack a small water bowl and a few treats. If you need more detailed information about a specific train route or additional pet-friendly amenities (e.g., pet relief areas), let me know and I can dig deeper!
